title: Ampfield Energy
description: Ampfield Energy designs, builds, finances and runs rooftop solar, battery storage and fleet charging on industrial and commercial sites in Sweden, Denmark, the Netherlands and the United Kingdom.

items.title: Rooftop solar
items.description: Panels on the roof you already have, sized to what the building uses.

items.title: Battery storage
items.description: Lower peaks and grid fees, and power that stays on when the grid fails.

items.title: Fleet charging
items.description: Depot charging for vans and trucks, within the grid connection you have.

items.title: Ampfield Pilot
items.description: Software that measures, controls and reports every kilowatt-hour on site.

items.title: Logistics and warehousing
items.description: Large roofs, vans that charge overnight, and cold stores that run all day.

items.title: Manufacturing
items.description: Steady daytime loads, and the peaks that set the grid bill.

items.title: Retail and commercial property
items.description: Landlord supply, tenants' power and charging for visitors.

items.title: Guides
items.description: How to plan, buy and run on-site energy, step by step.

items.title: Market and policy
items.description: Electricity prices, grid tariffs and the rules that move them.

items.title: Company news
items.description: New projects, new offices and what changes at Ampfield.

items.title: About us
items.description: Who we are, what we hold to, and how we got here.

items.title: Team
items.description: The nine people who run Ampfield.

items.title: Careers

items.title: Contact
